info.title: Lattiz API
info.description: Lattiz resource server. Auth is handled by Supabase; this API only validates Supabase-issued JWTs (JWKS / ES256, audience `authenticated`).

userId.description: Supabase user id (`sub`) of the active admin member.

email.description: Email claim, or null when the token has none.

envValue.description: Raw env string when the variable is set. Omitted for secret-like names.

value.description: JSON value. The registry parser checks the type and the range.

createdBy.description: Email of the member who granted access, when it is still known.

cancelAt.description: When the subscription is scheduled to end; null if it is not.

storageBytes.description: Sum of asset and branding bytes, or null when never measured.

createdAt.description: When the auth user was created.

date.description: Calendar day in the GA property time zone, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

sharePct.description: Share of all sessions in the window, 0–100.

sessionsDeltaPct.description: Null when the previous period had zero sessions.

daily.description: Exactly `rangeDays` points, oldest first, gap-filled with zeros.

report.description: Cached report jsonb, same shape as the tenant analytics report.

assetsObjects.description: Always 0 until object storage can count keys, not only bytes.

brandingObjects.description: Always 0 until object storage can count keys, not only bytes.

assetByteLimit.description:
`preview.max_asset_bytes` while the tenant is not paying.
Null when entitled, or when the configured cap is 0.

tags.description: Hasta 10 marcas de 24 caracteres. Reemplaza la lista entera.

expectedChargeCents.description: Annual fee including IVA, in cents.

cancelAt.description: When the subscription is scheduled to end; null if it is not.

stripeDashboardUrl.description: Stripe Dashboard link. `/test` when `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY` starts with `sk_test_`.

amountOff.description: Fixed amount in cents when the coupon is not a percent.

reason.description: Motivo que queda en la auditoría y en la metadata de Stripe.

sectionCount.description: Sections on the first GrapesJS page. The project JSON is not returned.

conversionRate30d.description: Converted / started in the last 30 days. Null when none started.

conversionRate90d.description: Converted / started in the last 90 days. Null when none started.

medianHoursToConvert.description: Median hours from preview start to the first later subscription.

churnRateThisMonth.description: Cancelaciones del mes ÷ pagadores al inicio. Null si no había pagadores.

atRisk.description: past_due más cancelaciones programadas, un cliente cuenta una vez.

assetsObjects.description: Last measured counts. `usageBytes` does not return an object count.

notifyCustomer.description: Sends the account-deleted notice. Defaults to true.

stale.description: True when the Data API failed and an expired cached report is served instead.

retryAvailableAt.description: When `POST /analytics/retry` will be accepted again (only for `failed`).

activeUsers.description: Distinct users in the last 30 minutes (not the sum of `perMinute`).

perMinute.description: Exactly 30 points oldest → newest, or empty when the per-minute breakdown failed.

unavailable.description: True when the Realtime API failed; the failure is cached for a minute.

amount.description: Price per billing period, in cents (minor currency unit).

effectiveAt.description: ISO date the scheduled change takes effect.

direction.description: `none` when the target is the current plan or the current plan is unknown.

effective.description: Upgrades apply now (prorated); downgrades at the end of the current billing period.

effectiveAt.description: ISO date a downgrade would take effect; null for upgrades.

currentPlan.description: Derived from the subscription's price; null without a subscription or for an unknown price.

acknowledgeLosses.description:
Required (true) when GET /tenants/:tenantId/plan-change-impact lists any loss;
otherwise the API answers 409 PLAN_CHANGE_IMPACT_NOT_ACKNOWLEDGED with the impact.

cancelAt.description: ISO date when the subscription ends, if a cancellation is scheduled; null otherwise.

amount.description: Price per billing period, in cents (minor currency unit).

price.description: Null when the tenant has never subscribed.

effectiveAt.description: ISO date the loss takes effect (period end for a downgrade).

items.description: Empty when nothing is lost. A non-empty list must be acknowledged to schedule the change.

coveredByPlan.description: True only when the name is free and both the first year and the renewal sit inside the tenant plan caps.

notCoveredReason.description:
Why an available domain is outside the plan: `purchase_over_cap` (first year),
`requires_pro` (renewal fits Pro but not this plan), `renewal_over_cap`
(renewal above every plan), or `price_unknown` (price could not be read —
fail closed). Null when covered or not available.

availableWithPro.description:
True only when this tenant is not on Pro, the name is free, the first year
fits the purchase cap, and the renewal fits the Pro cap but not the current plan.

renewalPriceUsdCents.description: What one renewal year costs Lattiz, in USD cents; null when it was not (or could not be) priced.

currency.description: Lowercase ISO 4217 code, as Stripe uses it.

taxRateBps.description: IVA en puntos base; el monto no lo incluye.

notCoveredReason.description:
Why an available domain is outside the plan: `purchase_over_cap` (first year),
`requires_pro` (renewal fits Pro but not this plan), `renewal_over_cap`
(renewal above every plan), or `price_unknown` (price could not be read —
fail closed). Null when covered or not available.

availableWithPro.description:
True only when this tenant is not on Pro, the name is free, the first year
fits the purchase cap, and the renewal fits the Pro cap but not the current plan.

renewalPriceUsdCents.description: The renewal price the coverage was decided with, in USD cents; null when it was not (or could not be) priced.

maintenanceFee.description: Charged every year starting with the second one; the registration itself is covered by the plan.

agreementTypes.description: Agreement types the user accepted — must match the quote's requiredAgreements.

agreedAt.description: ISO timestamp of when the user actually clicked "Acepto" — never fabricated.

jobId.description: Poll GET /domains/jobs/:jobId with this id for pipeline progress.

domain.description: Domain the tenant already owns at another registrar, e.g. "miempresa.com".

name.description: '@' for the apex, 'www' for the subdomain.

dnsInstructions.description: DNS records the tenant must create manually at their registrar.

relaunched.description: False when there was nothing to relaunch (no domain, or not suspended).

status.description: open: pago abierto; overdue: venció y aún puede pagar; paid: pago recibido, renovando; renewal_failed: pago recibido, Lattiz lo está resolviendo.

expiresAt.description: End of the current registration period, as an ISO timestamp.

lateDeadlineAt.description: Last moment a late payment is still accepted, as an ISO timestamp; null before the domain expires.

baseCents.description: Renewal price before IVA, in cents.

canPay.description: True when the tenant can start checkout for this cycle right now.

payBlockedReason.description: Por qué no puede pagar; null si puede o si ya pagó.

url.description: Stripe Checkout URL for the live renewal cycle.

tier.description: `basic`: every plan. `pro`: Pro (and higher) plans only.

accessible.description: Whether the caller's plan lets it pick this template. Derived on every read.

tier.description: `basic`: every plan. `pro`: Pro (and higher) plans only.

id.description: Profile id (matches the Supabase user id).

sub.description: Supabase user id (the `sub` claim of the verified JWT).

email.description: Email claim, when present in the token.

claims.description: The full set of verified JWT claims.

profile.description: Application profile, or null if none exists yet.

project.description: The GrapesJS project JSON to load into the editor (`storage.project`).
The full GrapesJS project JSON (editor state) to persist.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of the persisted change.

project.description: The GrapesJS project JSON (editor state) at publish time.

publishedAt.description: ISO timestamp the site was published.

id.description: Stable id for the asset in the GrapesJS asset manager.

src.description: Public object-storage URL, embedded as-is in the exported HTML.

mimeType.description: Stored type: `image/webp` unless the original was kept or passed through (SVG, animated).

width.description: Pixel width of the stored image; null when it could not be read (some SVGs).

height.description: Pixel height of the stored image; null when it could not be read (some SVGs).

originalBytes.description: Size of the uploaded file in bytes.

bytes.description: Size of the stored file in bytes.

templateId.description: Id of the template to seed the tenant's site from.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp the site schema was created.

templateId.description: Id of the template to switch the tenant's site to.

confirm.description: Must be true when the site already has content, to acknowledge the reset.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of the persisted change.

enabled.description: False when the API has no PEXELS_API_KEY; the dashboard hides "Fotos gratuitas".

pageUrl.description: The photo's page on pexels.com (attribution link).

thumbUrl.description: Small preview for the results grid (served by Pexels).

photoId.description: Pexels photo id from GET /stock/photos; the server fetches the image itself.

suspended.description: Vercel mapping removed after a lapsed subscription; DNS and ownership are intact.

createdAt.description: Set once, at `site_schemas` row creation — lets callers detect edits (`updatedAt !== createdAt`).

cancelAt.description: ISO date when the subscription ends, if a cancellation is scheduled; null otherwise.

socialPreviewUrl.description: Null means the tenant site falls back to the auto-generated OG image.

seoTitle.description: Null means the tenant site falls back to the tenant name.

seoDescription.description: Null means the tenant site falls back to a generic description.

ogSiteName.description: Null means og:site_name falls back to the resolved title.

locked.description:
True when an active plan is below the current template's tier (after a
downgrade): editing, saving and publishing are blocked until the tenant
picks an included template or upgrades. The published site stays online.

proIncluded.description: The plan includes Pro-tier extras: Pro templates, Pro editor blocks and Pro theme presets.

phone.description: Any common format; stored as E.164 (Mexico assumed when there is no country code).

timezone.description: IANA zone the hours are in; defaults to America/Mexico_City when read.

tenantId.description: `tenants.id` — the id expected by the editor route (`/editor/:tenantId`).

previewUrl.description: `https://{slug}.lattiz.app`; serves the published site until a custom domain is live.

slugIsCustom.description: False while the address is still the one generated at signup.

domainStatus.description: Provisioning state of the purchased domain (null until one is bought).

isEntitled.description:
Whether the tenant has a live paid subscription. Top-level rather than
inside `subscription`, which is null exactly when a tenant has none —
the case that most needs the flag. Derived only from `computeIsEntitled`.

previewState.description: `paid` when entitled; trial states are plan `none`; every other non-entitled tenant is `lapsed`.

canPublish.description: Publish, asset upload, and template changes. Saving a draft does not depend on this.

previewExpiresAt.description: When the free preview ends. Null for paid, lapsed, and not-yet-published tenants.

branding.description: Favicon / social-preview images injected into the published tenant site.

businessProfile.description: "Datos del negocio": feeds {{lz:*}} tokens and JSON-LD on the published site.

slug.description: Desired address; normalized and validated server-side so every failure carries a stable code.

previewUrl.description: Where the site is reachable before (or without) a custom domain.

slug.description: The normalized address that was checked.

available.description: True when the caller can claim it (including the address they already own).

reason.description: Why it cannot be claimed; null when available.

url.description: Public Supabase Storage URL, versioned so a replacement busts the CDN cache.
